payload.blocks: Phase 2 steps 8-10 (config patch in the supervisor grant); phases 5, 6, 9 and the rest continue.
payload.headline: Widen the heads-stable footprint by src/cli/command-registry.mjs so config patch --project-only can be declared?

parts.cause: packages/host-runtime/contracts/command-manifest.json is generated from src/cli/command-registry.mjs (config.patch properties). The manifest is in the footprint but its source is not, so the flag cannot be declared without a stale manifest. The owner-approved widen of 12:28 listed the manifest, not its source.

options.cost: One footprint line; the work is done and waiting.
options.does: Supervisor adds src/cli/command-registry.mjs to the plan footprint; the unit declares the project-only boolean on config.patch and regenerates the manifest through the existing exporter.
options.gain: Help, manifest and host agree; step 10's route can pass the flag; drift tests green.
options.harm: One more shared file; other plans editing the registry serialize with this land.
options.label: Widen footprint by command-registry.mjs

options.cost: Rewrite step 9; risk step 10 fails later.
options.does: Keep the flag in the Rust host and docs only; leave the registry and manifest untouched.
options.harm: The flag is undeclared in help and the manifest, against step 9; the confined route may refuse an unlisted flag.
options.label: Drop the manifest entry

parts.recommendation: Widen footprint by command-registry.mjs: the manifest is generated from it, so the flag cannot be declared any other way.

scope.allows: Adding src/cli/command-registry.mjs to this plan's footprint and declaring only the config patch project-only flag there.
scope.forbids: Any other registry change or footprint change.

parts.what: The host flag config patch --project-only is built and proven (golden_scope with host-provider 3/3, cli_projector 15/15, fgos-config 115/115). Two manifest drift tests fail because the flag is missing from the command registry.
